tasks.short: Advise clients on self-care and document agreed actions.

steps.what: Advise clients on self-care using their care instructions and check understanding
Write and verify the self-care advice and escalation note

loop.input: Worker's post-contact dictation of advice actually given, client understanding and any agreed escalation
loop.output: Draft contact note with advice and escalation statements traceable to dictation
loop.check: Worker checks clinical wording, medication references, negation and next steps; no new treatment recommendation is allowed
loop.stop: One draft; unclear source or unsupported advice requires manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Free speech contains context and qualifications that fixed fields cannot condense. Use native dictation first if it is sufficient.

steps.what: File the verified advice note in the community care record

tasks.design: Keep self-care advice and checking client understanding with the worker. Test native dictation in the care-record category of {OTHER}, then use a bounded note draft only if useful, with no write-back until the worker accepts the corrected final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Post-contact notes require translating remembered conversation into concise records.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech-driven reporting can draft from a short worker dictation rather than recording the client.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing a question outside the worker's scope and escalating safely.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanations to health literacy and detect misunderstanding.
tasks.altitude: Less note composition, with the same self-care support and escalation limits.

reach.learn: Anonymous theme aggregation and health literacy

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes Attendi dictation producing structured care reports; this supports note drafting, not automated self-care advice.

assumptions: Boundary is self-care advice and its contact record, not diagnosis, changing treatment or sending a referral.

The treating clinician already produces care instructions. s1 produces the discussion; s2 captures contact ID, date, advice actually given, understanding and escalation through counted worker dictation. Missing details are entered manually.
The 65% remaining in s2 includes dictation, semantic verification and corrections. No new client recording or client data-entry effort is assumed.
Try existing {OTHER} templates and plain dictation first; count no saving for an existing automatic write-back. Shares and savings are provisional rather than observed.
research_questions: Does drafting remain quicker after checking medication wording and escalation details?

already_counted.description: Dictation and complete clinical meaning check of the advice note

incremental.description: Sample note fidelity and check failed record writes

approvals.approved_version: Corrected self-care note accepted at the end of s2; subsequent edits invalidate acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: seven composition hours saved less1.5 upkeep. Low: dictation and correction leave only enough drafting benefit to cover upkeep. Same-care-record commitment and advice retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise people on improving health through diet and exercise.

steps.what: Select approved diet or exercise guidance for the group's needs
Advise clients about feasible diet and exercise changes and discuss barriers
Draft the contact record with topics covered and agreed next steps
Check and save the completed health advice record

tasks.design: Configure topic, language and audience filters for approved guidance in {DOCS}, keeping the worker's suitability decision. A contact template in the care-record category of {OTHER} reuses the selected resource IDs and headings; the worker enters actual responses and next steps and approves the final save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resources are hard to find by audience and contact notes repeat resource titles.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters and record templates address these bounded clerical tasks without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Affordability, disability, cultural context and motivation affect what changes are realistic.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a feasible change with the person rather than issue generic advice.

ambition.what: Run accessible healthy-eating sessions for residents with limited reading proficiency using approved visual materials.

tasks.altitude: A little less resource searching and repeated entry; the week remains centered on community conversations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: metadata filters can shorten resource searching, and native forms can reuse resource identifiers without generating health advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes resource selection, advice and recording the contact; it does not assume a new handout or external message.
The health education lead maintains resource ID, revision, topic, audience, language, format and approval status. s1 selects a resource; unmatched needs require manual selection with full fallback.

s3 captures contact or group ID, date, selected resources, topics covered and agreed next steps. The worker produces narrative fields; only identifiers and headings are reused. No model derives client goals.
First test native {DOCS} filters and {OTHER} forms. s1 loses only search time, not suitability judgement; advice and final review retain full time. Estimates need observation.
unknowns: Whether current records repeat resource details
research_questions: Do filters improve selection speed across languages without reducing suitability checks?

incremental.description: Keep guidance tags and contact-form references current

approvals.approved_version: Completed contact record reviewed against the discussion immediately before saving the exact revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net 6.5%: 4.5 search hours and 3 repeated-entry hours removed, less 1 upkeep. Low assumes weak metadata forces nearly all searches and note entry to stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop agreed health improvement plans for individuals, families or community groups.

steps.what: Explore health priorities, barriers and support preferences with participants
Agree feasible health goals, actions, responsibilities and review dates
Prepare the health improvement plan from agreed actions
Review the complete plan with participants and approve the final version
Send the approved health plan to its agreed recipients
Store the approved plan in the community care record

tasks.design: Configure a plan form in the care-record category of {OTHER} that renders the worker's entered goals and actions into an approved {DOCS} layout. Keep participant negotiation and final review human; send and file only the final version with the approved recipient list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Freeform plan documents require repeated formatting and copying after goals are agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A native plan form and document layout can reuse entered fields without inventing goals.
tasks.still_hard: Achievable goals require knowledge of household resources and participant preferences.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize coercion or unrealistic commitments and negotiate a fair plan.
tasks.altitude: Less plan formatting, with unchanged authority over goal setting and safeguarding.

reach.task: Coordinate practical support actions in a family plan

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a structured plan form can render entered actions into a consistent document; it cannot negotiate appropriate health goals.

assumptions: Boundary includes negotiating, writing, reviewing, sharing and filing the plan. These are supportive health plans, not new legal contracts; a binding contract needs separate local review.

s3 includes manual capture of participant IDs, goals, actions, responsible person, review dates and recipient permissions from s2. Its 65% remaining preserves capture and individual wording; only layout and repeated fields shrink.

s4 checks the final rendered plan with participants. If changes are requested, return to s3 and repeat final review before approval. Participant time is unchanged outside labour; no self-service entry is added.
Test native {OTHER} plan rendering first. Missing fields stay manual; absent recipient permission blocks sending. The estimate is provisional and existing automatic filing is excluded.
research_questions: Does the generated layout preserve each participant's actual wording and responsibilities?

incremental.description: Maintain plan layout and delivery permissions configuration

approvals.approved_version: Final rendered health plan and recipient list approved after all participant edits in s4; changes void approval
Same final health plan revision and correct care-record destination approved in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net 12.75%: 8.75 formatting hours plus 5 dispatch and filing hours removed, less 1 upkeep. Low assumes all plan text still needs manual preparation, leaving only dispatch and filing savings. Goal setting and final review do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advocate for community or individual health needs with agencies and providers.

steps.what: Review the person's mandate and evidence for the health need
Advocate with government agencies or providers and negotiate a response
Draft the written follow-up and case account of commitments
Check final commitments, permitted disclosure and recipients before release
Send the approved follow-up to the authorized agency contact
File the approved follow-up in the individual's or community's case record

tasks.design: Use a native follow-up form in the case-record category of {OTHER} and a fixed {DOCS} layout for written commitments. The worker captures the actual response and checks the complete follow-up against the mandate before gated sending and filing; advocacy conversations stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Follow-up accounts repeat contact details and copy commitments between documents and case records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and approved send-and-file actions can reuse entered text without interpreting agency promises.
tasks.still_hard: Overcoming institutional resistance and representing the person's preferences fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge an inadequate response and know when to escalate advocacy.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated follow-up administration, with unchanged advocacy authority.

reach.learn: Agency escalation routes and representation limits

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native follow-up forms can reuse contacts and the same approved text for dispatch and filing; advocacy negotiation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes evidence review, live advocacy and written follow-up; agency processing is outside the focal denominator and unchanged.

Existing case evidence and the person's mandate predate this task. s3 manually captures case ID, mandate scope, agency contact, actual response, agreed action, owner and deadline from s2; no structured promise is assumed to appear automatically.
s3 saves only repeated headers and formatting. Missing recipient permission or uncertain commitments remain manual and block release until resolved.
First test native {OTHER} follow-up forms and send-and-file controls. All baseline shares are provisional; no saving is claimed for an automatic filing action already present today.
research_questions: Can the same approved account serve as both follow-up and case record without disclosing excess information?

incremental.description: Check follow-up template fields and failed sends

approvals.approved_version: Final advocacy follow-up, authorized recipient and attachments checked in s4; edits invalidate approval
Same final follow-up with correct internal case destination approved in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net 7%: 3 formatting hours and 5 sending/filing hours removed, less 1 upkeep. Low assumes little written follow-up and existing automatic filing, leaving negligible return. Evidence review and live advocacy retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve trust, negotiation and health judgement while simplifying plans and contact records.
role.ambitious_version: Use small administrative returns to provide accessible support to underserved residents.
